behavior_change_from_previous: a minor release on 0.35.0 for a command list per device and a live view of a session: --cf DIR sends each selected device the file DIR/NAME in its place on the line, a selected device without its file refused commands_file_missing and two with one file name commands_file_name_collision (exit 5), and a collection over the run's own --cf lists commands_file_in_collection (exit 4); a run's commands go in the order written and --cf repeats, a declaration after a --cf refused declaration_with_commands_file; --live prints the device's bytes on standard output as the session reads them, refused live_option_conflict (exit 4) beside an option it sets aside or on a run through the daemon; command_plan_digest removed; the plan's commands_files and target_commands, the scoreboard's commands.files; commands_file_repeated and commands_file_is_directory retired; execution plan 15, plan report 4, and scoreboard 5 move, every other counter is 0.35.0's (configuration schema 6, registry 31, daemon IPC 12, command record 4, job manifest and summary 5, credential package 2, audit 2); scrapligo v1.4.3, and Go is 0.35.0's; the first submission after the upgrade drains a 0.35.0 daemon; see CHANGELOG.md

build.dependencies: vendored (go.mod, go.sum, vendor/); built with no network

daemon_upgrade_recovery.job_submission_schema: exact-current-only (the client's IPC schema and build)
daemon_upgrade_recovery.automatic_replacement: a client launching its own daemon (daemon.launch client) drains a daemon of another build at its own schema: idle, it exits and the client starts its own in the same invocation; busy, it finishes its jobs and exits after the last, each submission meanwhile refused daemon_draining (exit 112); a service account's daemon (daemon.launch systemd) is never drained by a client, and its unit is restarted
daemon_upgrade_recovery.incompatible_run_error: daemon_incompatible (a daemon of a newer IPC schema); daemon_draining (a drained daemon finishing its jobs)
daemon_upgrade_recovery.actual_lifecycle_replay: not run: the newest release whose daemon IPC schema (11) differs from this client's (12) is v0.29.0, whose daemon predates the drain that exits and listens on daemon.sock, which this client never reaches; the compatibility example ran before the number was committed: beside the released v0.35.0 daemon, at this client's schema and of another build, the client's daemon status stacked the two builds (compatible: false), its run's exercise drained the idle daemon and started its own (exit 0, no device contacted), and with the older daemon holding a job on the fake device the client's run was refused daemon_draining (exit 112), the daemon exiting after the job (evidence/ipc-schema-compat.log)
